description: Needs a rent.dev account: sign in when your client offers it, or call rent_signup first. Starts a command in the background and answers at once with its process id. The process id is valid while the sandbox runs; read its output with rent_get_process_output. The process ends with the sandbox. Arguments not listed here go to the REST route as they are, which refuses them by name.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id (`lse_…`) from rent_create_sandbox or rent_list_sandboxes. It names the sandbox for its whole life and keeps answering rent_get_sandbox, with the final state, after it ends.

name: rent_start_process
title: Start a background process
